sugyot.title_en: the majority of the rocks lie in the smaller part of the field and their minority in its larger part: are they sufficiently dispersed?

one foot in, one foot out -- what is the law? NO verdict of any kind follows: the sugya records only that for this they expelled R' Yirmiya from the study hall (a biographical gloss, NOT a verdict -- encoding the expulsion as one is this batch's falsifier 1), and no teiku token appears anywhere in the span. unresolved_silent is derived, never authored.
